## Model steps

```{r methods-code}
# Example: run_scenarios and one scenario visualisation
# Replace scenario_id as needed
woodhen_tbl <- run_scenarios("woodhen", csv_out = NULL, rds_out = NULL, keep_traj = FALSE, parallel = FALSE)
print(woodhen_tbl)

spec <- set_scenario("02_pig_control", "woodhen")
sim <- run_pva_core(spec, keep_traj = TRUE, seed = 123, verbose = FALSE)
sim_summary <- summarize_pva_result(sim)
sim_diagnostics <- diagnose_pva_result(sim)
```

## Sensitivity check (bounded)

```{r sensitivity}
base <- set_scenario("sensitivity_analysis", "woodhen")
s1 <- run_pva_core(base, keep_traj = FALSE, seed = 123)
s2 <- run_pva_core(modifyList(base, list(surv = base$surv * 0.90)),
                  keep_traj = FALSE, seed = 123)
s3 <- run_pva_core(modifyList(base, list(K = 250)),
                  keep_traj = FALSE, seed = 123)

compare_pva_results(
  list(s1, s2, s3),
  scenarios = c("baseline", "survival_minus_10pct", "K_250")
)
```
